design_disposition: Keep Dagong Hall as a plausible interpretive/learning context, not a verified 20–30 person classroom.
Keep all media and furniture movable/non-invasive.
Do not create a dimensioned interior plan from area/height prose.
Do not divide approximate 10 m overall height into invented floor-to-floor values.
Do not create RCP/service coordination until current survey/consultant evidence exists.
Use M0/M1/M2 mode switching so the concept survives narrower real conditions.
